title: Sign in
body: Credentials are issued by an administrator in User Management. A new user sets their own password from an email invitation.

title: Channel Management
body: The channel is active in Dubai, with Mortgage Loan assigned and enabled. Every product toggle moves only after checker approval.

title: Product Details
body: Amount and tenor boundaries, age limit and minimum salary, above the effective-dated pricing schemes attached to the product.

title: Pricing Matrix — step 1
body: Scheme identity and effective window, profit rate type, floor and ceiling rates, EIBOR source and the full fee set.

title: Pricing Matrix — step 2
body: STL, property status, transaction type and property location: the four factors that dimension the matrix.

title: Pricing Matrix — step 3
body: One row per factor combination. History Version recovers the pricing that actually applied on any past date.

title: Consent & disclosure library
body: Bureau Consent, Cooling Off, FATCA & CRS, Fund Transfer and Key Facts — each versioned with its last-updated stamp.

title: Version history
body: Every consent keeps its own version list, so the exact wording a customer saw on a given date can always be recovered.

title: Edit in place
body: Wording is edited in the portal, not in a release. The change publishes under the same Maker/Checker discipline.

title: Segmentation
body: Populations judged differently — residency and age here — each with its own Manual Review posture.

title: Edit segmentation
body: Each attribute switches on with its own condition and value. Nothing is typed free-form.

title: Attribute library
body: The attributes in play across every segment, chosen centrally so all segments stay comparable.

title: Filtration
body: Within-segment conditions — nationality, employment type, age band, minimum income, length of service — added row by row.

title: Deviation
body: Age and bureau-score exceptions are authored here as formulas — a controlled, logged breach instead of an outright decline.

title: Publish to Rule Engine
body: Nothing is live until it is explicitly pushed. The confirmation names the product and the channel it affects.

title: 63 calculated variables
body: Production formulas rendered as readable mathematics — DTI, DBR, affordability, monthly gross income, approved limit.

title: Income Multiplier
body: How much lending a given income is deemed to support, tuned per group and published as a numbered version.

title: Decision Boundary
body: The min–max envelope every calculated outcome has to fall inside, with the deviation type applied.

title: Higher Offer enabled
body: Offer the customer more than requested, delivered as a pre-approval letter message — up to ten, per product and channel.

title: Find any application
body: Search across every record by Application ID, newest first.

title: Narrowed
body: One record, with application type, relationship, status and originating channel on the row.

title: The case file
body: Declared and finalised income, DSR before and after settlement, bureau score, rule-engine result — read-only.

title: Primary and combined
body: Approved limit, decision status, existing liabilities, DBR room and finalised rate — for the primary applicant and the pair together.

title: Why it decided
body: Every criterion checked against the bank setup value, with the limit assignment result and each approved offer.

title: The arithmetic, exposed
body: Income × multiplier, maximum DBR per policy, affordability, DBR room, product bounds — down to the approved limit.

title: The evidence file
body: EID front and back, selfie, signature, EFR, PIA consent audit trail, AECB and CAM reports, and the AIP letter.

title: Route to a queue
body: Send the case on to Credit Queue L2 or L3 — allocation by authority level, recorded on the audit trail.

title: Override, inside policy
body: The officer picks product and offer; approval limit, tenor, rate and instalment recalculate live within policy bounds.

title: Users
body: Role, active status, when the record last changed and who changed it.

title: View PII Data
body: A deliberate grant — off by default, never inherited, approved through Maker/Checker, effective at next sign-in.

title: Roles
body: One row per role, one column per module. Every permission is explicit rather than inherited.

title: Log out
body: The session ends. Everything done inside it stays on the audit trail, attributed to the named user.
